about: Test programs that workload_fetch downloads. Each is built from source by .github/workflows/workloads.yml; its BUILD.txt lists the commits.

drawstress.title: bgfx 17-drawstress
drawstress.about: Draws a grid of cubes, dim^3 draw calls per frame (64 000 at dim 40): measures what one draw costs in native Metal and through a translation layer. Shaders are inside the program.
